z-m-34-13.title: Mitsetse miviri yakafanana pa k ipi: zvose 2 ne −2 here?
z-m-34-13.topic: Zvirevo zvezvimiro: mamiriro okuti mitsetse miviri ive yakafanana, nokufanana zvachose (mitsetse ine tsamba)
z-m-34-13.goal: Tarisa kana k dzose dzakawanikwa nokushandisa mamiriro okuti ma slope akaenzana chete dzichipa chaizvo mitsetse yakafanana, rongedza mamiriro okufanana zvachose, uye utsanangure kuti mhinduro inogona kuenderana netsananguro yokuti yakafanana.
z-m-34-13.material: Pane mutsetse l₁: kx + 2y = 4 nomutsetse l₂: 2x + ky = 4 (k inhamba chaiyo). Mubasa iri, 'yakafanana' zvinoreva mitsetse miviri yakasiyana isingasangani, uye kana zvirevo zviviri zviri mutsetse mumwe chete, 'zvinofanana zvachose' uye hazvisi zvakafanana. Harin akawana kukosha kwa k umo mitsetse miviri yakafanana sezvinoratidzwa pazasi. (Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinoratidzwa kubva pa 1.)
z-m-34-13.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako matambudziko anosangana nemamiriro
z-m-34-13.thinking.2: Kusiyanisa mamiriro umo mhinduro inoenderana netsananguro
z-m-34-13.prereq.1: Slope yomutsetse nemamiriro okuti mitsetse miviri ive yakafanana
z-m-34-13.s.s1.hint.0: Isa k = 2 ne k = −2 muzvirevo zviviri uye unyore kana mitsetse inomirirwa iri imwe chete kana yakasiyana.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti mamiriro okuti 'ma slope akaenzana' anosanganisira mitsetse yakafanana kana mitsetse inofanana zvachose.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.0: Kana mitsetse miviri yakafanana, ma slope ayo akaenzana.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.1: Slope ya l₁ i −k/2 uye slope ya l₂ i −2/k.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.2: Kubva pa −k/2 = −2/k tinowana k² = 4, saka k = 2 kana k = −2.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.line.3: Saka kukosha kwa k umo mitsetse miviri yakafanana ndi 2 ne −2.
z-m-34-13.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 4 hauna kururama. Kana k = 2, ma equation ose maviri anova 2x + 2y = 4, iri mutsara mumwe chete (unopindirana). Pasi pemutemo webasa iri, kupindirana hakusi parallel, saka nyaya imwe chete ye parallel i k = −2. (−2x + 2y = 4 ne 2x − 2y = 4 ndi y = x + 2 ne y = x − 2, mitsara parallel yakasiyana.)
z-m-34-13.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya 3 akasiyana (a, b) kuti mitsara ax + y = 1 ne 4x + by = 2 ive mitsara parallel yakasiyana. (Makosha e a anofanira kusiyana pakati pawo.)
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.0: Ita kuti ma coefficient e y mu equation mbiri akafanana, wobva waenzanisa ma coefficient e x nezvinhu zvisingachinji.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekuwana peya ine matambanuko akaenzana, ongorora kana imwe ye equation mbiri iri kuwanza kusingachinji kweimwe.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.hint.2: Chinja a kuita 1, 4, −1 nezvimwewo, uye ugadzirise b kuti ienderane.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.ok.c1: Chiyero che coefficient chinoenderana, saka matambanuko akaenzana.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.fail.c1: Matambanuko haaenzani. Nyora matambanuko emitsara miviri mu a ne b uye uaite akaenzana.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma equation maviri haasi mutsara mumwe chete.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune peya iyi, ma equation maviri mutsara mumwe chete (unopindirana). Peya inopindirana haisi parallel.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.explain: Kana ab = 4 uye a ≠ 2, mitsara parallel yakasiyana. Semuenzaniso, (1, 4), (4, 1), (−1, −4), (8, 0.5). Kune (2, 2), ma equation maviri i 2x + y = 1 ne 4x + 2y = 2, mutsara mumwe chete, saka haasi parallel.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei pane mapeya anogutsa ab = 4 asi asingapi mitsara parallel.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa peya ine ab = 4 mu equation mbiri uye uongorore kana kuwanza divi rimwe nechinhu chisingachinji kuchiita chakafanana neimwe.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wana kuti makosha e (a, b) api anopa kuwanza kusingachinji.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakaongorora here kuti ma equation maviri mumuenzaniso wangu chaizvoizvo mutsara mumwe chete?
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakatsanangura here musiyano pakati pe 'parallel' ne 'kupindirana' nemashoko angu?
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana a = 2, b = 2, ipapo l₁ i 2x + y = 1 uye l₂ i 4x + 2y = 2, iyo i equation imwe yakapetwa kaviri, saka mutsara mumwe chete. Mitsara inopindirana haisi mitsara parallel yakasiyana, saka inofanira kusiiwa.
z-m-34-13.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana a = 2, b = 2, mitsara miviri inopindirana zvachose ndokuenderana. Mitsara inopindirana haiwanikwi kusangana; inosangana pamapoinzi asingaperi.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.prompt: Mamwe mabhuku ekudzidzira anosanganisirawo 'mitsara miviri inopindirana' muparallel. Uchitevedza tsanangudzo iyoyo, makosha e k ndeapi umo l₁: kx + 2y = 4 ne l₂: 2x + ky = 4 ari parallel?
z-m-34-13.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kana ma equation maviri ari mutsara mumwe chete kana k = 2, uye zvinoitika pasi petsanangudzo inosanganisira kupindirana muparallel.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.hint.1: Dhirowa kuti mitsara miviri inoita sei kana k = 0.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.a: k = −2 chete: mhinduro yakafanana zvisinei netsanangudzo
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.a: Kana kupindirana kwakasanganisirwawo muparallel, nyaya pa k = 2 apo inova mutsara mumwe chete inofanira kuverengwa separallel futi.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.b: k = 2 chete: pa k = −2 mitsara miviri inosangana
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.b: Isa k = −2 mu equation uye uongorore kana mitsara miviri ichisangana.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.c: Zvose k = 2 ne k = −2: zvinoenderana netsanangudzo
z-m-34-13.s.s3.o.d: k = 0 inosanganisirwawo: haina matambanuko, saka ari parallel
z-m-34-13.s.s3.r.d: Kana k = 0, mutsara mumwe uri wakarara uye mumwe wakamira. Ongorora kana mitsara miviri ichisangana.
z-m-34-13.s.s3.explain: Kana kupindirana kwakasanganisirwa muparallel, ipapo k = 2 ne k = −2 zvose parallel. Pasi petsanangudzo inosiya kupindirana, k = −2 chete. Mhinduro imwe chete inopa mhinduro dzakasiyana zvichienderana nemutemo, saka unofanira kuongorora tsanangudzo iri mudambudziko.

z-m-34-05.title: Kana slope iri pakati pema slopes ekumagumo maviri, mutsetse unosangana nechikamu here?
z-m-34-05.topic: Equations dzezvimiro: mamiriro ekuti mutsetse unodarika poindi usangane nechikamu (range ye slope)
z-m-34-05.goal: Edza chirevo 'pakati pema slopes ekumagumo maviri' nema slopes chaiwo kuvaka counterexample, uye utaure range ye slopes dzinosangana nemhinduro yese kusanganisira mutsetse usina slope.
z-m-34-05.material: Pa coordinate plane pane poindi P(2, 0) nechikamu AB. A(0, 3), B(5, 3), uye chikamu AB, kusanganisira magumo ese maviri, i chikamu che y = 3 apo x i kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 5. Unoda kutsvaga range ye m apo mutsetse l unodarika P une slope m unosangana nechikamu AB. Seorin akati, "Slope yemutsetse kubva ku P kuenda ku A i −3/2 uye slope yemutsetse kuenda ku B i 1. Saka kana −3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1, unosangana nechikamu."
z-m-34-05.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mativi ese maviri erange usina kusiya
z-m-34-05.thinking.2: Kutarisa zvisiri mutemo sa mutsetse usina slope
z-m-34-05.prereq.1: Equation yemutsetse unodarika poindi une slope m
z-m-34-05.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuedza kana chirevo chaSeorin chakarurama. Kuedza kunovimbika zvikuru i kupi?
z-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza P(2, 0) nechikamu AB pa coordinate plane uye udhonze mitsetse kubva ku P kuenda ku A nekuenda ku B.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza slope imwe iri mukati merange inotaurwa nechirevo uye udhonze mutsetse iwoyo.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.a: Tarisa chete mitsetse inodarika magumo maviri A ne B, kuna m = −3/2 ne m = 1
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.a: Mitsetse miviri inodarika magumo inosangana pachena. Izvi hazviedze mitengo iri mukati merange inotaurwa nechirevo.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.b: Dhonza mufananidzo wakakwana, uye kana uchinzwa sekuti uri pakati pekumagumo maviri, enderera mberi
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.b: Kunzwa bedzi hakugone kukuudza kana mutengo uri mukati mechikamu unosangana chaizvo. Unofanira kuisa mutengo chaiwo uye utarise.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.c: Sarudza mutengo mumwe uri mukati mechikamu chinobvumidzwa nechirevo uye utarise kana mutsetse iwoyo unosangana nechikamu
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.c: Chirevo chinoti 'zvose zviri mukati zvinoshanda', saka kana mutengo mumwe chete uri mukati ukakundikana, chirevo chinoparara. Kuedza nemutengo uri mukati mechikamu i nzira yakananga zvikuru.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.o.d: Inyore se 'range ye slope inogara iri pakati pema slopes ekumagumo maviri' uye uenderere mberi
z-m-34-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakaiyeuka sesemutemo wakazara. Hauna kutarisa kana yakarurama kunzvimbo iyi ye poindi P nechikamu.
z-m-34-05.s.s1.explain: Chirevo chinoti 'kuna m wese ari mukati mechikamu, unosangana'. Kana ukasarudza mutengo mumwe uri mukati uye usingasangane, chirevo chakaipa. Semuenzaniso, unogona kuedza m = 0.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.prompt: Isa mitengo 4 yakasiyana ye m apo mutsetse une slope m unosangana nechikamu AB. Edza mitengo iri mukati nekunze kwerange yaSeorin.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.0: Taura nenzira ye m x-coordinate apo mutsetse y = m(x − 2) uri pa y = 3, uye utarise kana x iyoyo i kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 5.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura zviitiko apo m i positive uye negative, isa mitengo imwe panguva, uye ugadzire tafura yekuti inosangana here.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Mutsetse y = m(x − 2) unosangana nechikamu AB (magumo akasanganisirwa).
z-m-34-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Mutsetse une slope iyi hausangane nechikamu AB. Tarisa x-coordinate pa y = 3 kuti uone kana mutsetse nechikamu zvichisangana chaizvo kupi.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.explain: Unosangana kana m ≤ −3/2 kana m ≥ 1. Pakati pe −3/2 ne 1 (semuenzaniso 0, 0.5, −1), haisangane. Range yakapiwa naSeorin haisi 'range apo vanosangana' asi 'range apo havasangani'.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura, uchishandisa mutengo mumwe chaiwo we m, kuti nei range yaSeorin (−3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1) yakaipa.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza slope imwe iri mukati merange, isa y = 3 mu y = m(x − 2), uye utsvage x.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kana x yawakawana iri mukati merange ye x yechikamu (0 kusvika 5).
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakaisa chaizvo mutengo wandakashandisa mu equation yemutsetse kutarisa here?
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakapfuura kutaura kuti range 'yakaipa' uye ndakataura kuti rutivi rupi rwakarurama here?
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana m = 0, mutsetse i x-axis pachayo, saka hausangane nechikamu pa y = 3. I mutengo uri mukati mechikamu uye usingasangane, saka pfungwa yekutanga yakaipa.
z-m-34-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana m = −1, y = −(x − 2) ine x = −1 pa y = 3, iyo iri kunze kwechikamu. Kunyangwe slope iri pakati pema slopes maviri ekumagumo, inosangana kunze kwechikamu.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.prompt: Funga mitsetse yese inodarika P (kusanganisira mutsetse usina slope, x = 2). Ungatsanangura sei mitsetse inosangana nechikamu AB?
z-m-34-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga iwe pachako ma coordinates apo mutsetse x = 2 unodarika chikamu AB.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ubatanidze nerange ye m yawakatarisa munhanho yapfuura uye uiise pamwe mumutsetse mumwe.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.a: −3/2 ≤ m ≤ 1, uye mutsetse usina slope, x = 2, hausangane
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.a: Wakatarisa kare kuti mitengo iri murange iyi haisangane. Range i kurutivi rwakapesana.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.b: m ≤ −3/2 kana m ≥ 1, uye mutsetse usina slope, x = 2, unosanganawo
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.c: m ≤ −3/2 kana m ≥ 1, uye mutsetse usina slope, x = 2, hausangane
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.c: Range ye slope yakarurama. Tarisa iwe pachako kana mutsetse x = 2 unosangana nechikamu AB.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.o.d: Unosangana kuna m wese, uye mutsetse usina slope unosanganawo
z-m-34-05.s.s3.r.d: Tarisa kana mutsetse une m = 0 unosangana nechikamu.
z-m-34-05.s.s3.explain: x = 2 ne y = 3 zvinosangana papoindi (2, 3), uye poindi iyi iri pachikamu AB (0 ≤ 2 ≤ 5). Saka mitsetse ine m ≤ −3/2 kana m ≥ 1 nemutsetse wakamira x = 2 yose inosangana nechikamu. Kana ukatarisa mitsetse ine slope chete, zviri nyore kushaya mutsetse uyu.

z-m-34-10.title: Unofanira kuziva chii nezve poinzi C kuti area ye triangle itarwe?
z-m-34-10.topic: Ma equations ezvimiro: area ye triangle nemamiriro enzvimbo yepoinzi (kukwana kweruzivo)
z-m-34-10.goal: Rongedza ruzivo rupi nezve poinzi runodiwa uye rupi rusingakwani kuti area ye triangle itarwe, uye utsanangure seti yemapoinzi anoita area imwe chete.

Unoda kutsvaga nzvimbo yekatatu ABC, uye uchaongorora kana ruzivo rumwe chete pamusoro pepoinzi C rwukwana kugadzika nzvimbo. z-m-34-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kuruzivo rwega rwega, isa mapoinzi maviri anogona kuva C uye uenzanise kana kukwirira kwekatatu kwakafanana.

z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.a: Kukwirira kunochinja zvichienderana nokuti C iri papi pa y = x. Enzanisa nzvimbo pa (1, 1) ne (5, 5).
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.c: Koodhineti ye x yepoinzi C i 2
z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.c: Koodhineti ye x oga haikuudzi kukwirira kubva pahwaro, saka nzvimbo haina kugadzikwa. Enzanisa (2, 1) ne (2, 5).

z-m-34-10.s.s1.r.d: Mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa ane kukwirira kwakasiyana kwakawanda. Enzanisa kukwirira padyo ne (5, 0) napa (0, 5).
z-m-34-10.s.s1.o.e: Koodhineti ye y yepoinzi C i −3
z-m-34-10.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yakagadzikwa nehwaro AB (hurefu 6) nokukwirira, uye kukwirira ndiko kukosha kwakakwana kwekoodhineti ye y ye C. Kune dzimwe, kukwirira kwakawanda kunogoneka.

z-m-34-10.s.s3.r.a: Mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa ane kukwirira kwakasiyana kwakawanda. Enzanisa (3, 3) ne (5, 0).

z-m-34-10.s.s3.explain: Kuti nzvimbo ive 12, kukosha kwakakwana kwekoodhineti ye y ye C kunofanira kuva 4. Mutsetse mumwe pamusoro nomumwe pasi pe x-axis zvose zvinosangana nemamiriro. z-m-34-03.title: Kana makoefficient e x squared ne y squared akaenzana, nguva dzose idenderedzwa here?
z-m-34-03.topic: Zvirevo zvezvimiro: mamiriro okuti chimiro chakazara chechirevo chedenderedzwa chive denderedzwa
z-m-34-03.goal: Ratidza nomuenzaniso unopesana nokunyora patsva chirevo kuti x² + y² + (chirevo che degree yokutanga) = 0 chinogona kuva denderedzwa kana kwete zvichienderana nekukosha kwetsamba k, uye ududzire zvinoreva muganho (poinzi rimwe chete).
z-m-34-03.material: Pane chirevo x² + y² + 4x − 2ky + 10 = 0 (k inhamba chaiyo). Hyeonu akati, "Makoefficient e x squared ne y squared akaenzana, saka chero k iri yupi, chirevo ichi chinomirira denderedzwa."
z-m-34-03.prereq.1: Zvinoreva chirevo chedenderedzwa (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r²
z-m-34-03.prereq.2: Sei r² inofanira kuva yakanaka muchirevo chedenderedzwa
z-m-34-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa kukosha kwakaita se 0 ne 3 pa k imwe imwe panguva imwe uye urongedze kuti chirevo chinova nechimiro chipi.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira mazwi ane x namazwi ane y zvakasiyana uye utarise kana zvimiro zvakaita se (x + imwe nhamba)² ne (y − imwe nhamba)² zvichionekwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.a: Inogara iri denderedzwa chero k iri yupi: nokuti makoefficient e x squared ne y squared akaenzana
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.a: Makoefficient akaenzana anongoreva kuti zvingava nechimiro chedenderedzwa. Kana sikweya ye radius yakanaka inofanira kutarisirwa zvakasiyana.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.b: Zvichienderana nekukosha kwa k, inogona kuva denderedzwa kana kwete
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.b: Hauna kungotenda 'nguva dzose' uye wakasiya pachena mukana wokuti zvinoenderana nemamiriro. Ngatiedzei kutonga uku nokuisa kukosha kwa k.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana k i 0 chete haisi denderedzwa, uye kune kukosha kwose kumwe idenderedzwa
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona k = 0 chete sechisiri mutemo. Isa kukosha kwakawedzerwa kuti uone kana mamwe k asingapi denderedzwa zvakare.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.o.d: Hapana k inopa denderedzwa: izwi rinogara 10 rakakura zvikuru
z-m-34-03.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kuedza chirevo ichi nokuisa kukosha kukuru kwakaita se k = 3.
z-m-34-03.s.s1.explain: Haugoni kutaura kuti idenderedzwa nokuti makoefficient akaenzana. Unofanira kunyora patsva semasikweya uye utarise kuti kukosha kwokurudyi kwakanaka.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira muenzaniso unopesana unoratidza kuti chirevo chaHyeonu chakanganisa. Tsvaga uise nhamba dzakazara 3 dzakasiyana k dzisingapi denderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.hint.0: Isa k = 0, 1, 2, 3, ... nokurongeka, uye ugadzire tafura yokuti kukosha kwokurudyi kunochinja sei kana wagadzira mazwi e x ne y.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.hint.1: Paradzanisa mamiriro umo kukosha kwokurudyi kwakakura kupfuura 0 nemamiriro umo kusiri kudaro.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Kunyora patsva chirevo muchimiro chesikweya, kukosha kwokurudyi i 0 kana pasi, saka haisi denderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuna k iyi kukosha kwokurudyi (k squared minus 6) kwakanaka, saka idenderedzwa. Tsvaga kukosha kusingapi denderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.explain: Chinonyorwa patsva se (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = k² − 6, saka haisi denderedzwa kana k² ≤ 6. Nhamba dzakazara k dzinosangana ndi −2, −1, 0, 1, 2. Kuna k = 3 kana −4 idenderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti muganho wa k upi usingapi denderedzwa uye wakawana sei muganho uyu.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza imwe pa k dzawakaisa uye unyore chirevo patsva muchimiro chesikweya iwe pachako.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti kuna k ipi kukosha kwokurudyi kunova 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakatsanangura here mamiriro okuti kukosha kwokurudyi kuve kwakanaka nechirevo chandakanyora?
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakafunga here kuti chii chinoitika pamucheto (muganho) womuganho?
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kuita x ne y mapoka uye kunyora patsva se (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = k² − 6, sikweya ye radius i k² − 6. Kana kukosha uku i 0 kana pasi haisi denderedzwa, saka kana kukosha kwakakwana kwe k i √6 kana shoma, haisi denderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuishandura kuva chimiro chesikweya, rutivi rwokurudyi runova k squared minus 6. Kana kukosha uku kusipfuure 0, haigoni kuva ne radius, saka nhamba dzakazara dzose kubva ku −2 kusvika ku 2 hadzipi denderedzwa.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.prompt: Kana k = √6 (root 6), chimiro chipi chinomirirwa nechirevo x² + y² + 4x − 2ky + 10 = 0?
z-m-34-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga k apo mutengo wekurudyi i 0 uye uuise mu equation.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.hint.1: Uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti sikweya haigone kuva diki kupfuura 0, tsvaga kuti mapoindi api anogutsa equation.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.b: Verenga kuti radius i chii kana mutengo wekurudyi, k squared minus 6, wava 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.c: Hapana poindi chose inogutsa equation iyi
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.c: Tsvaga iwe pachako poindi inogutsa (x + 2)² + (y − k)² = 0.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.o.d: I denderedzwa rakadiki zvikuru rine radius padyo ne 0
z-m-34-03.s.s3.r.d: Hazvisi 'padyo ne', i 0 chaizvo. Funga kuti mapoindi mangani anosara kana i 0 chaizvo.
z-m-34-03.s.s3.explain: Kana k = √6, i (x + 2)² + (y − √6)² = 0. Kuti pundutso yema squares ive 0, ma squares ese maviri anofanira kuva 0, saka pane poindi imwe chete ine x = −2, y = √6.

z-m-34-08.title: Mutsara unowanikwa kubva pa equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri unogara uchipfuura napamapoinzi ekusangana here?
z-m-34-08.topic: Ma equations ezvimiro: mutsara unowanikwa kubva pa equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri (nzvimbo yemadenderedzwa maviri)
z-m-34-08.goal: Edza nemienzaniso kuti pasi pemamiriro api mutemo wekuti mutsara unowanikwa nekubvisa equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri unopfuura napamapoinzi awo ekusangana unogona kushandiswa, uye utaure iwe pachako mamiriro ekushandisa mutemo.
z-m-34-08.material: Pane denderedzwa C₁: x² + y² = 4 (pakati (0, 0), radius 2). Seoa akadzidza mutemo "Mutsara unowanikwa nekubvisa equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri divi nedivi imutsara unopfuura napamapoinzi akafanana emadenderedzwa maviri." Uchatarisa kana mutemo uyu ungashandiswa munyaya dzose, uchichinja denderedzwa idzva rimwe panguva.
z-m-34-08.prereq.1: Equation yedenderedzwa nenzvimbo yemadenderedzwa maviri (hukama pakati pemwero wemapakati nema radii)
z-m-34-08.prereq.2: Zvinoreva poinzi inogutsa ma equations maviri pamwe chete
z-m-34-08.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa rimwe panguva. Sarudza kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, enzanisa mwero pakati pemapakati emadenderedzwa maviri ne sum yema radii.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi iri pamutsara uye uiise zvakananga mu equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Wakauya nedenderedzwa C₂: (x − 2)² + y² = 4 (pakati (2, 0), radius 2). Kubvisa equations dza C₁ ne C₂ divi nedivi uye kupfupisa kwakapa mutsara x = 1.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mutsara x = 1 unopfuura napamapoinzi apo madenderedzwa maviri anosangana here?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.after: (1, √3) ne (1, −√3) mapoinzi anogutsa equations dzemadenderedzwa ose maviri, uye ose ari pa x = 1. Munyaya iyi mutemo unokodzera zvakanaka.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Hapana hukama: kubvisa ma equations kuverenga chete uye hakuna chekuita nehunhu hwezvimiro
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Poinzi yekusangana ipoinzi inogutsa ma equations ose maviri. Equation yakabvisirwa iri 0 zvakare papoinzi iyoyo. Kuverenga kune zvinoreva maererano nezvimiro.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Inopfuura napo: poinzi yekusangana yemadenderedzwa maviri inogutsa ma equations ose maviri, saka inogutsawo equation yakabvisirwa
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakapa chikonzero chekuti kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, ari pa equation yakabvisirwa. Ngatiedzei nedata inotevera kuti chikonzero ichi chechokwadi nenzira ipi.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Madenderedzwa maviri haasangani: nekuti kana equation yemutsara ikabuda, haisi denderedzwa
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Mhedzisiro yekubvisa ma equations edenderedzwa ichiva mutsara nekuti madenderedzwa maviri anosangana here zvinhu zvakaparadzana. Isa (1, √3) mu equation imwe neimwe.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Inopfuura napo: kuisa (1, √3) mu equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri, zvose zvinoshanda, uye poinzi iyi iri pa x = 1
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakatarisa nekuisa zvakananga. Wakatarisa poinzi imwe, saka hausati watarisa mutemo wose, asi umboo hwakakwana nyaya iyi.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Panguva ino wakauya nedenderedzwa C₃: (x − 6)² + y² = 4 (pakati (6, 0), radius 2). Kubvisa equations dza C₁ ne C₃ divi nedivi uye kupfupisa kwakapa mutsara x = 3.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mutsara x = 3 unopfuura napamapoinzi akafanana emadenderedzwa maviri here?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.after: C₁ iripo pa x kubva ku−2 kusvika ku2 chete, saka hapana poinzi ye C₁ pa x = 3. Mutemo ndewe 'kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, ari pa equation yakabvisirwa' chete, uye hautaure kuti pane mapoinzi ekusangana nekuti equation yakabvisirwa imutsara. Kutonga kwekare kunofanira kugadziriswa nekuisa mamiriro.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Pane poinzi yakafanana pa x = 3: nzira yakafanana nekare, saka mhedzisiro yakafanana
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange kana nzira yakafanana, nzvimbo yedenderedzwa yakachinja. Tarisa kuti ma x-coordinates e C₁ ari murenji ripi.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hapana poinzi yakafanana pa x = 3: C₁ iripo pa x ndi2 kana pasi chete
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakatarisa renji zvakananga kubva pakati ne radius yedenderedzwa. Kunyange kana mutsara ukabuda kubva pa equations, unofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana kana pane mapoinzi akafanana.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: x = 3 iri padhuze nepakati pe C₃, saka inosangana ne C₃ chete
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ma x-coordinates e C₃ anobva ku4 kusvika ku8. Tarisa kana mutsara x = 3 unosangana ne C₃.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kunyange kana mutsara wabuda, kuti pane poinzi yakafanana here kunofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana, saka usasarudze parizvino
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwekungwarira. Asi kana ukatarisa renji remadenderedzwa, unogona kusarudza pakarepo.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Pakupedzisira wakauya nedenderedzwa C₄: (x − 4)² + y² = 4 (pakati (4, 0), radius 2). Kubvisa equations dza C₁ ne C₄ divi nedivi uye kupfupisa kwakapa mutsara x = 2.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hukama hupi huripo pakati pemutsara x = 2 nemadenderedzwa maviri C₁, C₄?
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.after: (2, 0) ndiyo poinzi yakafanana yega inogutsa equations dza C₁ ne C₄ zvose, uye iri pa x = 2. Munyaya iyi x = 2 ndiyo mutsara unobata madenderedzwa ose maviri. Mutemo unoshandawo kana pane poinzi imwe yekusangana.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Pane mapoinzi maviri ekusangana emadenderedzwa maviri pa x = 2
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Isa x = 2 mu equation ye C₁ uye uverenge kuti y ndi chii.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Madenderedzwa maviri anosangana papoinzi imwe (2, 0), uye mutsara x = 2 unopfuura napoinzi iyoyo
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kunyange kana pane poinzi imwe yekusangana (nyaya yekubata), equation yakabvisirwa inopfuura napoinzi iyoyo. Unogona kutarisa nekuisa zvakananga.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Madenderedzwa maviri haasangani, saka x = 2 haina zvainoreva
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tarisa kana (2, 0) ichigutsa equations dzemadenderedzwa ose maviri.
z-m-34-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: x = 2 inosangana ne C₁ chete uye haisangani ne C₄
z-m-34-08.s.s1.reflect: Mutemo wekutanga waiva wakarurama mune dzimwe nyaya here, uye mamiriro akaiswa mune dzimwe here? 'Kana pane mapoinzi ekusangana, ari pamutsara' kwakasiyana sei ne 'kana mutsara wabuda, pane mapoinzi ekusangana'?
z-m-34-08.s.s2.prompt: Wakawana mutsara nekubvisa equations dzemadenderedzwa maviri divi nedivi. Usati wataura kuti mutsara unopfuura napamapoinzi akafanana emadenderedzwa maviri, nyora kuti chii chaunofanira kutanga warutarisa, uye upe muenzaniso mumwe umo mhedzisiro yakasiyana.
z-m-34-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisazve nyaya ye C₃ kubva mudanho rapfuura uye unyore zvakanga zvakasiyana.
z-m-34-08.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mwero pakati pemapakati kana madenderedzwa maviri achisangana nekana asingasangani.
z-m-34-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ndakajekesa here kuti chinofanira kutariswa ndechekuti 'pane mapoinzi ekusangana here'?
z-m-34-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mumuenzaniso wandakapa, unogona kuona here kuti mutsara unobuda asi hapana mapoinzi ekusangana (kana imwe chete)?
z-m-34-08.s.s2.model.0: Unofanira kuenzanisa mwero pakati pemapakati emadenderedzwa maviri nema radii uye utanga watarisa kana madenderedzwa maviri achisangana chaizvo. Kana ari kure, senge madenderedzwa e radius 2 ane mapakati pa0 ne6, kunyange equation yakabvisirwa ikapa mutsara x = 3, hapana poinzi yakafanana.
z-m-34-08.s.s2.model.1: Unofanira kutarisa kuti mwero pakati pemapakati hausi mukuru kupfuura sum yema radii. Kana madenderedzwa maviri e radius 2 ane mapakati ari 6 kure, haasangani, asi mutsara senge x = 3 uchiri kubuda.

z-m-34-09.title: Kana ukachinja vertex ye right triangle, circumcenter inoramba yakadaro here?
z-m-34-09.topic: Ma equations ezvimiro: right triangle ne circumcenter yayo (kutsvaga poinzi kubva pamamiriro emwero)
z-m-34-09.goal: Edza nemienzaniso ye lattice-point kufungidzira kwekuti circumcenter haichinji kana divi rimwe radzikamiswa uye vertex ye right-angle ichifamba, uye siyanisa zvinochinja kana kona isiri right angle.
z-m-34-09.material: Pa coordinate plane pane A(0, 0), B(10, 0). Poinzi C(p, q) yakaiswa ne q > 0, ine ma integer coordinates (lattice point), uye kuti ∠C = 90°. Circumcenter ye triangle ABC ipoinzi iri pamwero wakaenzana kubva kuma vertices matatu A, B, C. Ian akati, "Kana ndikachinja nzvimbo ye C, circumcenter ichafamba pamwe chete nayo."
z-m-34-09.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja

z-m-34-09.prereq.3: Hukama pakati penzira kana mitsara miviri iri perpendicular
z-m-34-09.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoitika kucircumcenter kana ukachinja C uchichengeta ∠C = 90°? Sarudza zvichibva pazvaunofunga zvino.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzirisa C imwe ine ∠C = 90° uye udhirowe zvishoma kuti circumcenter iri kupi.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzirisa imwe C zvakare uye uenzanise kana circumcenter iri panzvimbo imwe chete.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.a: Circumcenter haichinji chero C iri kupi: inogara iri poinzi imwe chete
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.b: Circumcenter inochinja nenzvimbo ye C: nekuti vertex inochinja
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.b: Sa Ian, wakafunga kuti kana vertex ichichinja, circumcenter ichachinja. Tarisa mumienzaniso chaiyo kana circumcenter ichifamba.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.c: Circumcenter inogara iri poinzi imwe chete ne right-angle vertex C
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.c: Kana mwero kubva ku circumcenter kuenda ku C uri 0, mwero kuenda ku A ne B waifanira kuva 0 zvakare. Funga kana izvo zvingagoneka.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.o.d: Mu right triangle, circumcenter inogara iri kunze kwe triangle
z-m-34-09.s.s1.r.d: Wakatonga nechimiro chete, pasina kutsvaga nzvimbo ye circumcenter. Tsvaga nzvimbo mumuenzaniso mumwe.
z-m-34-09.s.s1.explain: Kutonga uku kuchaedzwa mudanho rinotevera nekugadzira iwe pachako ma lattice points C. Chero zvazvingaita, zvakakosha kutarisa nemienzaniso.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma lattice points C(p, q) 3 akasiyana anogutsa ∠C = 90°. (q > 0, p ne q ndema integers)
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kuti C ive right angle, funga kuti hukama hupi nzira kubva ku C kuenda ku A nenzira kubva ku C kuenda ku B dzinofanira kuva nahwo.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja p kubva ku1 kusvika ku9 uye ugadzire tafura kutarisa kana q iri integer.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.hint.2: Yera uye uenzanise mwero kubva pamapoinzi awakawana kuenda ku (5, 0).
z-m-34-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Nzira mbiri kubva ku C kuenda ku A nekuenda ku B dziri perpendicular, saka ∠C ndi right angle.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.fail.c3: ∠C haisi right angle. Wedzera product yezvikamu zvakatwasuka nezvikamu zvakamira zveshanduko kubva ku C kuenda ku A neshanduko kubva ku C kuenda ku B, uye utarise kana iri 0.
z-m-34-09.s.s2.explain: Ma lattice points C anogutsa mamiriro ndi (1, 3), (2, 4), (5, 5), (8, 4), (9, 3). Mapoinzi ose aya ari pamwero we5 kubva ku (5, 0). Ndiko kuti, mapoinzi ari padenderedzwa rine AB se diameter.

z-m-34-01.title: Kana pane mapoindi matatu akapiwa, vertex yechina i yega here?
z-m-34-01.topic: Zvirevo zvezvimiro: vhetekisi yechina yeparallelogram (makoodhineti emapoinzi)

z-m-34-01.material: Pachirongwa chekoodhineti pane mapoinzi matatu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(1, 3). Unoda kugadzira parallelogram ine mavhetekisi mana ari mapoinzi matatu aya nepoinzi D. Mazita emavhetekisi akapiwa pasinei nokurongeka kwokubatanidzwa, uye parallelogram inofanira kuva quadrilateral chaiyo ine mapoinzi mana asiri pamutsetse mumwe. Jiho akati, "D i (5, 4) chete."

z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakatogadzika mapoinzi akatarisana nokungotarisa mazita A, B, C. Verenga zvakare kuti kurongeka kwemazita emapoinzi hakuna kupiwa.

z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakazvigadzikira iwe pachako nheyo yokuparadzanisa mamiriro (poinzi rinotarisana na D). Unofanira kutarisa izvi nemakoodhineti chaiwo.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.o.d: Zvisina muganho: kunyange kana ukaisa poinzi rechina pachirongwa papi zvapo, parallelogram inogona kugadzirwa
z-m-34-01.s.s1.r.d: Mamiriro okuti mativi akatarisana akafanana anorambidza D zvikuru. Haigoni kuva papi zvapo.
z-m-34-01.s.s1.explain: D inowira panzvimbo yakasiyana zvichienderana nokuti poinzi rinotarisana na D ndi A, B, kana C. Kana pane zvechokwadi nzvimbo nhatu, uchazvitarisa nemakoodhineti munhanho inotevera.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makoodhineti 3 akasiyana e D kuti mapoinzi mana A, B, C, D (nokurongeka kupi zvako) ave mavhetekisi mana eparallelogram.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.0: Muparallelogram yawatodhirowa, nyora kuti x ne y imwe neimwe inochinja zvakadini kubva pa A kuenda ku B, uye uenzanise kana zvakafanana kurutivi rwakatarisana.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza imwe pa A, B, C sepoinzi rinotarisana na D, uye utakure shanduko pakati pamapoinzi maviri akasara kunzira kubva ku D kuenda kupoinzi iroro.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.hint.2: Mushure mokuwana rimwe, chinja poinzi rinotarisana uye udzokorore nzira imwe chete.

z-m-34-01.s.s2.explain: D iri panzvimbo nhatu (5, 4), (−3, 2), (3, −2). Ndiwo mamiriro umo D inotarisana na C, B, ne A zvichiteerana. Semuenzaniso, kuna (5, 4), shanduko yakananga nokukwira (4, 1) kubva pa A kuenda ku B yakafanana neshanduko kubva pa C kuenda ku D.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora nemashoko ako kuti sei unogona kutaura kuti D ine nzvimbo nhatu idzi chete.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Batanidza mapoinzi matatu awakawana uye utarise kana mativi akatarisana akafanana.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Verenga kuti mangani pa A, B, C anogona kusarudzwa sepoinzi rinotarisana.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Mutsananguro yangu, nheyo yokuparadzanisa mamiriro yakajeka here?
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakaenderera here kunyora chikonzero che 'hapana dzimwe'?
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana poinzi rinotarisana na D ri A, D i (5, 4); kana ri B, (−3, 2); kana ri C, (3, −2). A, B, C chete ndivo vanogona kutarisana, saka nhatu idzi ndidzo dzose.
z-m-34-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Pane nzira 3 dzokusarudza poinzi rimwe pamapoinzi matatu sorinotarisana na D, uye poinzi rinotarisana rakagadzikwa, D yakagadzikwa pane imwe. Saka D ine nzvimbo 3 zvakanyanya.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, senge A(0, 0), B(2, 2), C(4, 4). Chii chinoitika kuparallelogram ine mapoinzi mana semavhetekisi?
z-m-34-01.s.s3.hint.0: Isa A, B, ne C pachirongwa chekoodhineti uye utarise kana ari pamutsetse mumwe.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga D imwe uchishandisa nzira yapakuvamba uye uise nzvimbo dzemapoinzi mana.
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.a: Haigoni kugadzirwa: mapoinzi mana ari sandara pamutsetse mumwe
z-m-34-01.s.s3.o.b: Ichigadzirwa panzvimbo 3: ingoshandisa nzira iri pamusoro sezvayakaita
z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.b: Kana ukashandisa nzira sezvayakaita, unowana mapoinzi, asi hauna kutarisa kana mapoinzi mana ose ari pamutsetse mumwe.

z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.c: Dambudziko haisi kuti mamiriro anodzikira, asi kuti quadrilateral inogona kugadzirwa zvachose here.

z-m-34-01.s.s3.r.d: Dhirowa kwakaiswa mapoinzi akagadzirwa kubva pamapoinzi ari pamutsetse wakananga.

z-m-34-02.title: Mutsetse unobata unodhirowa kubva papoinzi P(3, 5) kudenderedzwa: tinogona kuvimba nemhinduro here?
z-m-34-02.topic: Zvirevo zvezvimiro: mitsetse inobata inodhirowa kubva papoinzi riri kunze kwedenderedzwa (chimiro chechirevo chemutsetse)
z-m-34-02.goal: Tanga watonga kuti pamusoro pe mitsetse inobata yakadini inofanira kuvapo kubva papoinzi kuenda kudenderedzwa, wobva watsvaga nokururamisa mamiriro akashaikwa (mutsetse usina slope) mukugadzirisa kwakawana imwe chete.
z-m-34-02.material: Pane denderedzwa x² + y² = 9 (pakati pa origin, radius 3) nepoinzi P(3, 5). Jiho akaedza kutsvaga mitsetse inobata inodhirowa kubva ku P kudenderedzwa uye akagadzirisa seizvi. Nhamba dzemitsetse yokugadzirisa dzinotanga pa 1.
z-m-34-02.thinking.1: Kutsvaga chikonzero kana mhedzisiro yakasiyana nezvakatarisirwa
z-m-34-02.thinking.2: Kutsvaga iwe pachako mamiriro akashaikwa uye kuatarisa
z-m-34-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva chinhambwe chiri pakati pepoinzi nomutsetse
z-m-34-02.prereq.2: Zvinoreva chirevo chedenderedzwa x squared plus y squared = r squared
z-m-34-02.prereq.3: Musiyano pakati pemitsetse ine slope neisina (mitsetse yakafanana ne y-axis)
z-m-34-02.s.s1.prompt: Usati wataridza kugadzirisa, mitsetse inobata ingani inogona kudhirowa kubva papoinzi P(3, 5) kuenda kudenderedzwa iri?
z-m-34-02.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa chinhambwe kubva pakati pedenderedzwa kuenda papoinzi P ne radius uye utonge kuti P iri papi.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa mifananidzo yamamiriro umo P iri padenderedzwa, mukati, nokunze, uye uverenge kuti mitsetse inobata ingani inogona kudhirowa.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.a: 1: mutsetse mumwe chete unobata unogona kudhirowa kubva papoinzi rega rega
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.a: Kana poinzi riri padenderedzwa, pane mutsetse mumwe unobata. Tarisa kana poinzi P riri padenderedzwa, mukati, kana kunze.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.b: Hazvigoni kuzikanwa: unoda kuziva chinhambwe pakati papoinzi nedenderedzwa, uye hausi kuchiziva izvozvi
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.b: Chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda ku P chinogona kuwanikwa kubva pamakoodhineti oga. Kachiri nguva yokutaura kuti ruzivo harukwani.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.c: 2: P iri kunze kwedenderedzwa, saka mumwe unogona kudhirowa kurutivi rwega rwega
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakafungidzira huwandu hwemitsetse inobata kubva panzvimbo yepoinzi. Izvi zvinova nheyo yokuenzanisa nemhedzisiro yokugadzirisa.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.d: Zvisina muganho: mimwe yemitsetse inodhirowa kubva ku P kuenda kudenderedzwa inogara ichibata
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.d: Mutsetse unobata ndiwo unobata denderedzwa papoinzi rimwe chete. Funga nomufananidzo kuti mitsetse yakadaro iri mingani.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.explain: Chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda ku P i √34 (inenge 5.8), chakakura kupfuura radius 3, saka P iri kunze kwedenderedzwa. Kubva papoinzi riri kunze kwedenderedzwa, mitsetse 2 inobata inogona kudhirowa.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mukugadzirisa kwaJiho une dambudziko. (Pangava nemitsetse inodarika mumwe une dambudziko.)
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana mutsetse wega wega uchibva zvakarurama pamutsetse wapamberi, uye kumitsetse isiri kuverenga, funga kana fungidziro kana mhedziso yavanotaura ichigara ichishanda.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana chirevo chemutsetse chinoshandiswa nokugadzirisa chichigona kumirira mutsetse wose unopfuura papoinzi P.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.0: Kana slope yomutsetse unobata i m, mutsetse unobata i y − 5 = m(x − 3).
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.1: Chinhambwe kubva pakati pedenderedzwa (0, 0) kuenda kumutsetse uyu chinofanira kuenzana ne radius 3, saka |5 − 3m| / √(m² + 1) = 3.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.2: Kuita sikweya mativi ose nokupfupisa kunopa 25 − 30m + 9m² = 9m² + 9, saka m = 8/15.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.3: Saka mutsetse unobata i y − 5 = (8/15)(x − 3) chete.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 1 wakafungidzira kuti mutsetse unobata une slope, uye mutsetse 4 ndiyo mhedziso ye 'imwe chete' yakabva pafungidziro iyoyo. Kuverenga (mitsetse 2 ne 3) kwakarurama. Mutsetse usina slope (mutsetse wakafanana ne y-axis) haugoni kunyorwa muchimiro y − 5 = m(x − 3), saka wakasiyiwa mukugadzirisa.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti sei mutsetse mumwe chete unobata wakabuda uye chirevo chomutsetse unobata wakashaikwa, uye unyore nzira imwe yokutarisa kuti mutsetse iwoyo unobata chaizvo.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.0: Funga mutsetse chirevo chaJiho chisingagoni kumirira ne m yipi zvayo.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yera zvakananga chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse iwoyo.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakawana nokunyora ndega chirevo chomutsetse wakashaikwa here?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakatarisa here chaizvo kuti unobata nenzira yandakanyora?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukaita slope se m, mutsetse wakamira wakananga hauigoni kuratidzwa, saka wakasiyiwa. Wakasara ndi x = 3, uye chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse uyu i 3, chakaenzana ne radius, saka unobata.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.1: Mutsetse x = 3, wakafanana ne y-axis, usina slope, saka hauna kubuda muchirevo. Kuisa x = 3 pamwe chete nedenderedzwa x² + y² = 9, vanosangana papoinzi rimwe chete (3, 0), saka unobata.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.2: Chirevo che slope m hachigoni kuratidza mutsetse wakamira pa x-axis, saka mutsetse umwe unobata wakashaikwa. Wakashaikwa ndi x=3, uye sezvo chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse uyu i 3, mutsetse unobata.

z-m-34-04.title: Kana pundutso yema squares ekureba kuenda kumapoindi maviri i constant, chimiro chakadini chinobuda?
z-m-34-04.topic: Equations dzezvimiro: locus yemapoindi ane pundutso yema squares ekureba kuenda kumapoindi maviri i constant
z-m-34-04.goal: Tarisa nequation fungidziro yakaitwa kubva pamapoindi mashoma, uye urongedze, pamwe nemamiriro, kuti kuunganidzwa kwemapoindi kunochinja sei kubva padenderedzwa kuenda kupoindi imwe kuenda kusina mapoindi chose sezvo constant ichichinja.
z-m-34-04.material: Pa coordinate plane pane mapoindi maviri A(−2, 0), B(2, 0). Funga nezvekuunganidzwa kwemapoindi ese P(x, y) anogutsa PA² + PB² = k. (PA² i sikweya yekureba pakati pepoindi P nepoindi A, ndiko kuti, kureba pakati pe P ne A kwakaitwa squared, uye k i constant yakagadzwa.)
z-m-34-04.thinking.2: Kutaura mamiriro emhedziso kana constant ichichinja
z-m-34-04.s.s1.prompt: Data ichaonekwa imwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza pfungwa yako yekuti kuunganidzwa kwemapoindi kune chimiro chakadini.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho imwe neimwe, siyanisa zvakachinja kubva panhanho yapfuura nezvakasara zvakafanana.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kutarisa kana chimiro chawasarudza chakarurama, sarudza poindi imwe uye uverenge PA² ne PB² iwe pachako.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Wakagadza k = 16 uye wakaedza mapoindi mashoma. P(2, 0), P(0, 2), P(−2, 0) zvose zvinogutsa PA² + PB² = 16.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti mapoindi ese anogutsa mamiriro anogadzira chimiro chakadini?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Mapoindi matatu aya ari padenderedzwa rine pakati pa origin neradius 2. Asi mapoindi matatu bedzi haagone kusimbisa 'i denderedzwa', uye zvakakodzera kuritora sefungidziro.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mapoindi matatu ese ari pakureba 2 kubva pa origin, saka zvinoratidzika kuti i denderedzwa. Ndinoda kutarisawo mamwe mapoindi
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Iyi i fungidziro yakanaka inosiya yakazaruka kuti kutonga kwako kunogona kuchinja sei kana mapoindi akawanda.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Enzanisa ma coordinates emapoindi matatu. Unogona kutarisa kana ari pamutsetse mumwe.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mapoindi matatu aya ndiwo ese aripo. Hapana mamwe mapoindi
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Verenga kana poindi imwe, semuenzaniso (0, −2), ichigutsa mamiriro.

z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana poindi ichinzi P(x, y) uye kunyorwa nema coordinates, PA² = (x + 2)² + y² uye PB² = (x − 2)² + y². Kuawedzera nekucheneswa kunopa 2x² + 2y² + 8 = k.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana k = 16, mapoindi ese anogutsa mamiriro anogadzira chimiro chakadini?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16, saka x² + y² = 4. Fungidziro yekutanga (denderedzwa) yasimbiswa ne equation, uye radius i 2. Iyi i nyaya apo unogona kuchengeta fungidziro sezvayakaita.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Denderedzwa rine pakati pa origin neradius 4
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Verenga kuti x² + y² i mutengo wei, uye utarise kana mutengo uyu i sikweya yeradius kana radius.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Denderedzwa rine pakati pa origin neradius 2
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Fungidziro yakasimbiswa ne equation. Mhedziso iyi yakabva pakuverenga kuti sikweya yeradius i 4.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mapoindi ari pakureba kwakafanana kubva ku A ne B, ndiko kuti, y-axis
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mamiriro haasi PA = PB, asi kuti PA² + PB² i constant.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Denderedzwa rine pakati pa origin neradius 8
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kana uchipatsanura 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16 ne 2, tarisa kana wakabatawo 8.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kucheneswa kunopa x² + y² = (k − 8)/2. Zvino chinja k uye utarise zviitiko k = 8 ne k = 4.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana k = 8 uye kana k = 4, chii chinoitika kumapoindi anogutsa mamiriro?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana k = 8, saka x² + y² = 0, saka pane origin chete, uye kana k = 4, saka x² + y² = −2, saka hapana poindi inogutsa. I denderedzwa chete kana k > 8. Fungidziro yekutanga yakachinja kuita mhedziso ine mamiriro ekuti k iri mukati merange imwe.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sezvo k ichidzikira, denderedzwa rinoitawo rakadiki: kana k = 8 radius i 2, uye kana k = 4 radius i 1
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Verenga kuti unowana chii kana ukaisa k = 8 mu (k − 8)/2.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Denderedzwa rinogadzirwa zvisinei ne k, uye pa k = 4 i denderedzwa rine radius ine negative
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Radius i kureba, saka haigone kuva negative. Funga kana pane poindi inogutsa x² + y² = (nhamba ine negative).
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana k = 8 i poindi imwe chete, origin, uye kana k = 4 hapana poindi yakadaro chose
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakasarudza nhamba yemapoindi uchifunga kuti x² + y² i 0 kana negative rini.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kana k = 8 hapana poindi yakadaro, uye kana k = 4 i poindi imwe chete, origin
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tarisa kana mutengo waunowana nekuisa k = 8 ne k = 4 mu (k − 8)/2 i 0 kana negative.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.reflect: Fungidziro yawakaita kubva pamapoindi matatu ekutanga yakava sei mushure mekuitarisa ne equation? Uye kana k ichichinja, chikamu chipi chemhedziso chakagadziriswa nekuwedzera mamiriro?

z-m-34-06.title: Pa x-axis, pane poindi imwe chete iri pakureba kwakafanana kubva kumitsetse miviri here?
z-m-34-06.topic: Equations dzezvimiro: kutsvaga poindi kubva pamamiriro ekureba kwayo kumitsetse
z-m-34-06.goal: Tsvaga uye utarise kuti pangava nemapoindi maviri pa x-axis ari pakureba kwakafanana kubva kumitsetse miviri, uye utonge, pamwe nemamiriro, kuti nhamba inochinja sei kana mitsetse miviri yakafanana.
z-m-34-06.material: Pane mutsetse l₁: 3x + 4y − 12 = 0 nemutsetse l₂: 4x + 3y − 9 = 0. Unoda kutsvaga poindi P(t, 0) pa x-axis ine hurefu kumitsetse miviri hwakaenzana. Minseo akawana P(3, 0), akatarisa kuti hurefu hwose hwuviri i 3/5, uye akati, "Iyi ndiyo poindi chete ine hurefu hwakaenzana."
z-m-34-06.thinking.0: Kukahadzika kana mhinduro yawakawana ndiyo yese
z-m-34-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mhinduro dzakati wandei nenzira yakarongeka
z-m-34-06.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti nhamba yemhinduro inochinja zvichienderana nemamiriro (kana mitsetse yakafanana)
z-m-34-06.s.s1.prompt: Pane imwe chete, sezvinotaurwa naMinseo here? Fungidzira kuti mapoindi mangani pa x-axis ane hurefu hwakaenzana kumitsetse miviri.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga hurefu hwuviri kuna t = 3 uye utarise kuti hwakaenzana, wobva waenzanisa zvinoitika kana ukaisa t = 0 ne t = 4.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.hint.1: Mufomula yekureba kubva papoindi kuenda kumutsetse, tarisa kuti denominator i chii uye kuti mutengo uri mukati meabsolute value unogona kuva nezviratidzo zvipi.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.a: 0: hurefu kumitsetse miviri hunogara hwakasiyana pa x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.a: Minseo atoawana poindi imwe, P(3, 0), apo hurefu hwakaenzana. Haisi 0.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.b: 1: kana ukaenzanisa hurefu uye ukagadzirisa, mutengo mumwe we t unobuda
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa nemimwe mitengo ye t kana poindi yakawanikwa naMinseo i yese chaizvo. Fomula yekureba ine absolute value.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.c: Dzisingagumi: mapoindi ane hurefu hwakaenzana ari kwose pa x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.c: Verenga iwe pachako hurefu hwuviri kuna t = 0 uye utarise kana hwakaenzana.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.o.d: 2: zvinoita sekuti poindi imwe ine hurefu hwakaenzana inobuda kurutivi rumwe nerumwe
z-m-34-06.s.s1.r.d: Hauna kumira mushure mekuwana poindi imwe uye wakakahadzika kana pane dzimwe. Unofanira kugadzirisa equation chaizvo kuti utarise.
z-m-34-06.s.s1.explain: Watarisa kuti P(3, 0) i imwe, asi unozoziva kana pane dzimwe nekugadzirisa equation bedzi. Ngatidzitsvagei isu pachedu munhanho inotevera.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pemapoindi P(t, 0) pa x-axis, tsvaga mapoindi 2 akasiyana ane hurefu kumitsetse l₁ ne l₂ hwakaenzana, uye uise t.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mafomula maviri ekureba uye utarise kana ma denominators akafanana. Kana akafanana, funga kuti ma numerators anofanira kuva nehukama hupi.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.hint.1: Funga, nemienzaniso yenhamba (semuenzaniso 3 ne −3), kuti nhamba mbiri dzine absolute value imwechete dzinogona kuva nehukama hupi.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Hurefu kubva ku P(t, 0) kuenda kumitsetse miviri hwakaenzana. (Ma denominators emitsetse yose miviri i 5, akafanana.)
z-m-34-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Hurefu hwuviri hahuna kuenzana. Tsvaga hurefu kumutsetse mumwe nemumwe uye uenzanise.
z-m-34-06.s.s2.explain: Pane mapoindi maviri, t = 3 ne t = −3. Kana t = −3, hurefu hwose hwuviri i 21/5. Izvi nekuti kana ukabvisa absolute value, zviitiko zviviri zvinobuda, chiratidzo chimwechete nechiratidzo chakapesana. Mapoindi maviri aya ndiwo apo mitsetse miviri inoparadzanisa kona pakati pemitsetse miviri (y = x + 3 ne x + y = 3) inosangana ne x-axis.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino mitsetse miviri yachinja kuva yakafanana. Kana l₁: 3x + 4y − 12 = 0 ne l₃: 3x + 4y + 8 = 0, pane mapoindi mangani pa x-axis ari pakureba kwakafanana kubva kumitsetse miviri?
z-m-34-06.s.s3.hint.0: Isa t = 2/3 ne t = 0 uye uverenge hurefu hwuviri hwakashanda.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa nzira yapfuura pamitsetse miviri iyi sezvayakaita uye utarise kana zviitiko zvose zviri zviviri zvinogoneka.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.a: 1: mutsetse uri pakati pakati pemitsetse miviri yakafanana unosangana ne x-axis papoindi imwe
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.b: 2: sezvakaita mubvunzo wapfuura, nzvimbo mbiri dzinobuda pa x-axis
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.b: Kare mitsara miviri yakasangana. Tarisa nequation kana nzvimbo mbiri dzichibudawo zvakafanana kana ari parallel.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.c: 0: mitsara miviri iri parallel haisangani, saka hapana poinzi iri pamwero wakaenzana
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.c: Kusasangana kwakasiyana nekusava nepoinzi iri pamwero wakaenzana. Funga nezvepakati pemitsara miviri iri parallel.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.o.d: Isingaperi: kana mitsara iri parallel, poinzi imwe neimwe ine mwero wakaenzana
z-m-34-06.s.s3.r.d: Verenga mwero miviri kune t = 0 uye utarise kana dzakaenzana chaizvo.
z-m-34-06.s.s3.explain: Mu |3t − 12| = |3t + 8|, 3t − 12 = 3t + 8 haishande, uye 3t − 12 = −(3t + 8) inopa t = 2/3 chete. Kana mitsara iri parallel, imwe yenyaya dzinobva pakubvisa absolute value inonyangarika, saka huwandu hunodzikira. Kufungidzira kwekutanga (2) kunochinja zvichienderana nemamiriro.

z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.2: Origin haigutsi inequality, saka divi rakapesana nepairi origin ndiro renji.
z-m-34-07.s.s1.line.3: Saka renji re y > 2x riri pazasi pemutsara.

z-m-34-11.title: Kana ukaturikira slope, ndiwo mutsetse wakaratidzirwa here?
z-m-34-11.topic: Zvirevo zvezvimiro: kuratidzirwa mumutsetse y = x (kuenzanisa nzira mbiri)
z-m-34-11.goal: Enzanisa nzira mbiri dzokutsvaga kuratidzirwa mumutsetse y = x, utonge kuti ndeipi inovimbika, uye utsvage utsanangure mamiriro umo mutemo wereciprocal yeslope usingashande (mutsetse wakatwasanuka).
z-m-34-11.material: Ngatiti l' mutsetse unowanikwa nokuratidzira mutsetse l: y = 2x + 1 mumutsetse y = x. Gaon akati, "Poinzi (x, y) riri pa l rinofambiswa kuenda ku (y, x), saka ingochinjana x ne y muchirevo," ndokuwana y = (x − 1)/2. Jian akati, "Slope inova reciprocal yayo uye y-intercept inoramba yakafanana," ndokuwana y = x/2 + 1. Ma slope emhedzisiro mbiri akafanana asi zvirevo zvakasiyana.
z-m-34-11.thinking.0: Kusarudza nzira yokutonga kana nzira mbiri dzichipa mhedzisiro dzakasiyana
z-m-34-11.prereq.1: Kuratidzira poinzi (makoodhineti epoinzi (a, b) rakaratidzirwa mumutsetse y = x)
z-m-34-11.s.s1.prompt: Nzira inovimbika yokutonga kuti ndeipi yemhedzisiro mbiri yakarurama ndeipi?
z-m-34-11.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga poinzi rimwe pa l uye unyore (x, y) ne (y, x) kwariri.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.hint.1: Tsiva poinzi muzvirevo zviviri uye uenzanise kana zvichishanda.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.a: Chirevo chiri nyore chinogona kuva chakarurama, saka vimba nemhedzisiro yaGaon
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.a: Chirevo kuva nyore hakuna chokuita nokuti chakarurama here. Unofanira kuedza nokuisa nhamba.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.b: Ma slope emhedzisiro yose mbiri i 1/2, saka zvose zvinoonekwa zvakarurama
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.b: Kunyange ma slope akafanana, mitsetse ine ma intercept akasiyana mitsetse yakasiyana. Tarisa kana mutsetse mumwe chete l' wakasarudzwa.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.c: Isa poinzi rakawanikwa nokuchinjana x ne y yepoinzi riri pa l muzvirevo zviviri
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.c: Poinzi rakaratidzirwa rinofanira kuva pa l'. Poinzi rimwe rinogona kuparadzanisa mhedzisiro mbiri.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.o.d: Tsiva poinzi pamunosangana l ne y = x mumitsetse yemhedzisiro mbiri kuti uone kana riri pairi
z-m-34-11.s.s1.r.d: Poinzi riri pa y = x harifambi pakuratidzira. Poinzi rokusangana ipoinzi rinofanira kuvapo pa l' zvakare. Nzira iyi yakarurama zvakare.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.explain: Poinzi (0, 1) riri pa l rinofambiswa kuenda ku (1, 0). Kuritsiva muchirevo chaGaon kunoshanda, uye muchirevo chaJian kunopa 1.5, saka hakushande. Poinzi rokusangana (−1, −1) harifambi, saka rinofanira kuvapo pa l' zvakare, uye zvakare chaGaon chakarurama uye chaJian chakanganisa.
z-m-34-11.s.s1.acc.0: Poinzi rokusangana ra l ne y = x harifambi pakuratidzira, saka rinofanira kuvapo pa l' zvakare. Kutarisa kuti poinzi iri rinoshanda muchirevo chipi inzirawo inovimbika.

z-m-34-11.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti mapoinzi akachinjana ari pamutsetse upi.
z-m-34-11.s.s2.r.b: Tarisa kana mapoinzi anowanikwa nokuchinjana x ne y yemapoinzi (0, 3) ne (1, 3) ari pa l ari pa y = 3.
